events.title: Demo Update v0.2.21710 - One Month In
events.summary: Hello Starfinders! ⭐ It has been a month since the demo launched. Over 26,000 downloads, 128 countries, 96% completion rate, and 1,500+ survey responses, with a ton of useful feedback. Thank you! Early Access: We are moving the launch from Q4 2026 to Q1 2027.
